chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is a position in Hellfire that no one from among the people deserves, except the killer of Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) and Yahya ibn Zakariyya (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Who is destined for a unique position in Hellfire according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the unique eschatological status of the killers of Imam Al-Husayn and Yahya ibn Zakariyya, linking the Ahl al-Bayt's martyrdom to the broader prophetic lineage. In Shia scholarship, this exclusive station in Hellfire highlights the gravity of opposing the Imams, serving as a theological anchor for the concept of *Khasasiyya* (special distinction) granted to the Prophet's family. The parallel with Yahya ibn Zakariyya connects the Ahl al-Bayt's suffering to the earlier prophets, reinforcing the continuity of divine truth and persecution.
